arxiv-1704-08386.creator: Richard Garner
arxiv-1704-08386.description: Abstract . Tangent categories were introduced by Rosický as a categorical setting for differential structures in algebra and geometry; in recent work of Cockett, Crutwell and others, they have also been applied to the study of differential structure in computer science.

arxiv-2103-13412.title: Majorana bound states in topological insulators without a vortex
arxiv-2103-13412.creator: Henry F. Legg, Daniel Loss, Jelena Klinovaja
arxiv-2103-13412.description: Abstract We consider a three-dimensional topological insulator (TI) wire with a non-uniform chemical potential induced by gating across the cross-section. This inhomogeneity in chemical potential lifts the degeneracy between two one-dimensional surface state subbands. A magnetic field applied along the wire, due to orbital effects, breaks time-reversal symmetry and lifts the Kramers degeneracy at zero-momentum.

arxiv-2401-11008.title: Helmholtz-Decomposition and Optical Flow: A new method to characterize GCamP recordings
arxiv-2401-11008.creator: Michael Gerstenberger, Dominik Juestel, Silviu Bodea
arxiv-2401-11008.description: Abstract During deep sleep and under anaesthesia spontaneous patterns of cortical activation frequently take the form of slow travelling waves. Slow wave sleep is an important cognitive state especially because of its relevance for memory consolidation. However, despite extensive research the exact mechanisms are still ill-understood. Novel methods such as high speed widefield imaging of GCamP activity offer new potentials.

arxiv-2507-11735.title: Non-additive measures for quantum probability?
arxiv-2507-11735.creator: Gabriele Carcassi, Christine A. Aidala
arxiv-2507-11735.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gabriele Carcassi, Christine A. Aidala. It is well-established that quantum probability does not follow classical Kolmogorov probability calculus. Various approaches have been developed to loosen the axioms, of which the use of signed measures is the most successful (e.g. the Wigner quasiprobability distribution). As part of our larger effort Assumptions of Physics, we have been considering the various roles of measures, which are used in physics not only for probability, but also to quantify the count of possible states and configurations.

arxiv-2510-05730.title: Signatures of superconducting Higgs mode in irradiated Josephson junctions
arxiv-2510-05730.creator: Aritra Lahiri, Juan Carlos Cuevas, Björn Trauzettel
arxiv-2510-05730.description: Abstract The Higgs mode, originally proposed in the context of superconductivity, corresponds to oscillations of the amplitude of the superconducting order parameter. Recent THz-domain optical studies have found signatures consistent with the Higgs mode, but its unambiguous detection is still challenging.

pmc-10633942.title: Breaking the taboo: qualitative analysis of the sexuality in people with acquired motor disability
pmc-10633942.creator: Gema Sologuren-García, Carmen L Linares, Jackeline R Flores, Katty Mendoza-Mamani, Rinna M Pilco, Gloria Escobar-Bermejo, Soledad Sotelo-Gonzales, Guicela Palza-Portugal
pmc-10633942.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundGlobally 1 in 7 people experience some type of disability. In Latin America, as in other regions, there are programs focused on the protection of sexual and reproductive rights of this population group. However, to date, in Peru there are no programs, protocols or guidelines that include a specialist (sexologist or trained health professional) in the health system to improve the quality of life and well-being of this population.

pmc-10706691.title: Psychological Distress in Alzheimer’s Disease Family Caregivers: Gender Differences and the Moderated Mediation of Resilience
pmc-10706691.creator: José Manuel Ponsoda, María Ángeles Beleña, Amelia Díaz
pmc-10706691.description: Different studies have reported gender differences in the variables of psychological distress, burden, social support, and resilience in family caregivers of relatives with Alzheimer’s disease; however, there is no clear evidence of the specific role of burden, social support, and resilience between gender and psychological distress. The aim of the present study is to clarify the role of these variables.

pmc-11331788.title: Assessing family relationships through drawing: the Family Life Space
pmc-11331788.creator: Marialuisa Gennari, Caterina F. Gozzoli, Giancarlo Tamanza
pmc-11331788.description: The Family Life Space (FLS) is a graphic instrument that may aid the relational assessment of families. This interactive instrument involves all members of the family in a joint task, that of collectively making a drawing of their own family system and it allows the gathering of information related to the overall family organization.

pmc-11386290.title: Patterns of single and multiple HPV infections in female: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11386290.creator: Dan Zhou, Jing Xue, Yaqiong Sun, Liling Zhu, Ming Zhao, Meimei Cui, Min Zhang, Jingjing Jia, Limei Luo
pmc-11386290.description: BackgroundData on the patterns of single and multiple HPV infections are largely limited to small size studies, and the regional difference have not been systematically examined.MethodsA literature search was conducted using PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science databases up to Sept 22, 2023. The pooled prevalence of HPV infection were calculated using random-effects meta-analysis.

pmc-11396879.title: Nuclear-Magnetic-Resonance-Spectroscopy-Derived Serum Biomarkers of Metabolic Vulnerability Are Associated with Disability and Neurodegeneration in Multiple Sclerosis
pmc-11396879.creator: Taylor R Wicks, Irina Shalaurova, Richard W Browne, Anna Wolska, Bianca Weinstock-Guttman, Robert Zivadinov, Alan T Remaley, James D Otvos, Murali Ramanathan, Chih-Li Lin
pmc-11396879.description: Purpose: Metabolic vulnerabilities can exacerbate inflammatory injury and inhibit repair in multiple sclerosis (MS). The purpose was to evaluate whether blood biomarkers of inflammatory and metabolic vulnerability are associated with MS disability and neurodegeneration. Methods: Proton nuclear magnetic resonance spectra were obtained from serum samples from 153 healthy controls, 187 relapsing–remitting, and 91 progressive MS patients.

pmc-11462284.description: 1. AbstractAcute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a highly aggressive cancer form that affects myeloid cells, leading to the excessive growth of immature white blood cells (WBCs) in both bone marrow and peripheral blood. Timely AML detection is crucial for effective treatment and patient well-being.

pmc-11463016.title: “Surviving against the odds. The impact of peer support workers on a chronically suicidal adolescent in secure residential youth care: a single case report from the Netherlands”
pmc-11463016.creator: Shireen P. T. Kaijadoe, Karin S. Nijhof, Helen Klip, Arne Popma, Ron H. J. Scholte
pmc-11463016.description: BackgroundThe use of peer support workers to support suicidal adolescents is underdeveloped. This study focuses on the effects of a one-year intervention with peer support workers on a chronically suicidal adolescent residing in a secure residential youth care facility in the Netherlands. Moreover, we explore the mechanisms that underpin the role of peer support workers in detail.

pmc-13080879.title: Targeting LY6E Inhibits Neuroblastoma Progression and Suppresses M2 Macrophage Polarization
pmc-13080879.creator: Lijuan Li, Yu Zeng, Qinfen Zhang, Gaojian Zhuang, Yu Liu, Xuan Wang, Yuqi Wang, Hao Chi
pmc-13080879.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Neuroblastoma is a pediatric malignancy characterized by significant clinical heterogeneity. Although MYCN amplification is a well‐established marker of high‐risk disease, its interplay with the tumor immune microenvironment—particularly tumor‐associated macrophages (TAMs)—remains poorly understood. In this study, we developed an integrated gene signature incorporating genes associated with both MYCN amplification status and TAM infiltration, leading to the identification of 16 differentially expressed genes implicated in both biological processes.

pmc-13677336.title: An intrascrotal bioadhesive nanoplatform for sustained hydrogen delivery ameliorates age-associated testicular dysfunction
pmc-13677336.creator: Shu Liang, Jiawei Lv, Zun Li, Zheng Li, Jiachun Jiang, Shaoqing Yu, Cheng Wang, Xiongjun Wang, Lingyun Xiao, Guanzhen Yu
pmc-13677336.description: Testicular aging is characterized by progressive spermatogenic decline. Accumulating oxidative injury and insufficient metabolic support from Sertoli cells may contribute to this process. Although molecular hydrogen has shown antioxidant potential, its therapeutic application in reproductive aging is limited by rapid dissipation after administration. To overcome this barrier, we developed the localized hydrogen-releasing system S-H/B.
